description: This file contains a function 'sendRepo' that retrieves repository information from GitHub using the Probot framework, including fetching the latest commit SHA, and validates the data structure with 'isValidRepoData'.

methods.name: sendRepo
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches repository details including latest commit SHA and validates the data.

methods.name: isValidRepoData
methods.description: Validates the structure and content of the repository data object.
